Add an RFC 5322 composer to jmap-mime (address headers, Subject, Message-ID, In-Reply-To, References, Date from sentAt/receivedAt, MIME-Version, RFC 2047 for non-ASCII headers, multipart from textBody/htmlBody/attachments or bodyStructure, bodyValues as QP or base64, blobId parts fetched from the backend).
